name: video-editing-app
description: Electron video toolkit powered by FFmpeg
author: Frost

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run react:start" "npm run electron:watch" "wait-on tcp:3000 electron/dist/preload.js && set ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 && electron ."
scripts.move:exe: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const dist=path.join(root,'dist');if(!fs.existsSync(dist)) process.exit(0);for(const name of ['VideoEditingApp-x64.exe','VideoEditingApp-x86.exe']){const target=path.join(root,name);if(fs.existsSync(target)) fs.rmSync(target,{force:true});}const artifacts=fs.readdirSync(dist).filter((name)=>/^VideoEditingApp-(x64|x86)\.exe$/i.test(name));for(const name of artifacts){fs.copyFileSync(path.join(dist,name),path.join(root,name));console.log('Copied dist/'+name+' -> '+name);}"
scripts.dist:win: npm run react:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis --x64 -c.win.executableName=VideoEditingApp-x64 -c.win.artifactName=VideoEditingApp-x64.${ext} && npm run move:exe
scripts.dist:win32: npm run react:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis --ia32 -c.win.executableName=VideoEditingApp-x86 -c.win.artifactName=VideoEditingApp-x86.${ext} && npm run move:exe
scripts.dist:win:all: npm run react:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis --x64 -c.win.executableName=VideoEditingApp-x64 -c.win.artifactName=VideoEditingApp-x64.${ext} && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis --ia32 -c.win.executableName=VideoEditingApp-x86 -c.win.artifactName=VideoEditingApp-x86.${ext} && npm run move:exe
scripts.dist:mac: npm run react:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --publish never --mac --x64
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run react:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --publish never --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:all: npm run react:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --publish never --mac --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:win:all && echo macOS release files are built in GitHub Actions or on a macOS machine with npm run dist:mac:all
scripts.dist:dir: npm run react:build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --dir
